name: DRAFT Cherubini 2015 coiled nylon Reference Coil, held at dataset C stretch

source.detail: digitized: Cherubini et al. 2015 (AIP Advances 5:067158) Fig 7 dataset C rising temperature (isometric) + Fig 9 right isothermal unloading curves read at the reference stress

metadata.notes: DRAFT -- not reviewed, not in the manifest. Coiled nylon 6 fishing line (homochiral 'Reference Coil'; precursor monofilament d = 0.5 mm; made under 0.5 kg; coil index 1.4, bias angle 18 deg; annealed at 150 degC), heated by hot air in a test chamber. One specimen. REFERENCE STATE: the coil held at dataset C's elongation (20 mm, 28.6 % of L0 = 70 mm) at 25 degC under sigma0 = 20.34 MPa (our linear fit of the digitised rising-temperature points of Fig 7 dataset C, extrapolated from the first plotted point at 36.2 degC; Table I gives 20.41 MPa). At zero load the coil is coil-bound and barely shortens on heating (paper: 'preload knee'), so this record describes the pre-loaded operating point, not the unloaded coil. INPUT: chamber air temperature RISE above 25 degC (the paper's ambient isothermal test); the isometric cycles started at 24 degC. Bench temperature uncertainty +/-5 degC. BLOCKED: Fig 7 dataset C, rising temperature (red asterisks), second thermal cycle, length held; force_axial_N = -(sigma(T) - sigma0) x A, the rise in tension above the reference preload, negative = pulls toward the base. A = pi d^2/4 = 1.9635e-07 m^2 from the quoted precursor diameter, which is the paper's own definition of nominal stress (check: 0.5 kg gives 24.97 MPa; paper says 25). The paper gives no area directly. The descending-temperature circles agree (fit slope 0.1785 against 0.1910 MPa/degC rising). FREE: strain change at constant tension sigma0 read across the isothermal UNLOADING curves (Fig 9 right) at 25, 60, 88, 122 degC, times L0; contraction along -X, frame X base->tip. These are separate isothermal tensile tests, not an isotonic heating test; isotonic tests are not in this paper (it cites its Ref. 11 for them). The 60 degC curve has a gap in the trace right at sigma0, where a Fig 9 triangle was masked out. The 25 degC unloading curve reaches sigma0 at strain 0.2605, not the held 0.286; the isometric triangle at 0.286 and 25 degC in Fig 9 sits at 22.6 MPa. Referenced to the held strain instead, the free displacements would be -5.17, -8.54, -13.72 mm; read from the loading/unloading AVERAGE curves (Fig 9 left) they would be -3.14, -5.62, -9.51 mm. Reading error (cherubini2015_figs_reading_error.json): about 0.013 N on force, 0.15 degC on temperature, 0.22 mm on free displacement, plus up to 0.18 mm between the line-fit and nearest-row readings; sigma0 fit standard error 0.21 MPa (0.041 N). length_m is L0 (unloaded, ambient); the coil works at 1.286 L0. Polarity_axial -1: contracts on heating.
